title: Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) - NHS
content: Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), also called myelodysplasia, is a type of blood cancer. It's rare and mostly affects people over 70 years old. What is myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)? Symptoms Causes Tests and next steps Treatment Help and support
